clubs.name: SUPER UW

clubs.description: SUPER UW advocates for Palestinian equality and raises awareness through art, sports, and community actions. The group organizes events such as banner‑making sessions, football games, and cultural gatherings.

clubs.description: SEI is a group of undergraduate students working to establish a Sustainability General Education Requirement on campus.

clubs.name: Synaptech at University of Washington
clubs.about: Synaptech is an engineering RSO dedicated to advancing neurotechnology through hands-on student projects and…
clubs.description: Synaptech is an engineering RSO dedicated to advancing neurotechnology through hands-on student projects and interdisciplinary education. We focus on developing real-world applications using neural interfaces while exploring the vital intersections of neuroscience, neural engineering, and neuroethics. By providing accessible hardware resources and fostering a collaborative community, we empower students to transform their ideas into impactful innovations. We're open to everyone, from all majors!

clubs.name: Taiko Kai
clubs.about: Taiko Kai’s purpose is to celebrate and share the traditional Japanese performing art of taiko drumming across all…
clubs.description: Taiko Kai’s purpose is to celebrate and share the traditional Japanese performing art of taiko drumming across all communities by educating each other on the artform and cultural significance. UW students can join regardless of experience or background; we aim to nurture everyone's curiosity about taiko. Taiko Kai offers holistic development through providing a variety of opportunities for members to be involved: typical practices for honing drumming techniques, the maintenance and care of our equipment, creative work such as uniform-making and designing promotional material, and experiencing the range of venues and organizations that invite us to perform for them. Through our efforts to bring taiko to all audiences while providing the space for members to contribute how they want to, we've cultivated a space that upholds our values of inclusivity and empowerment.

clubs.name: Taiwanese Overseas Student Association
clubs.about: Connects Taiwanese students with cultural events and member discount perks.
clubs.description: TOSA_UW brings together Taiwanese students at UW, offering a membership card with discounts at local eateries and organizing cultural activities like mahjong nights. Their posts highlight deals at Seattle Best Tea and other favorite spots.

clubs.name: Taiwanese Student Association
clubs.about: Taiwanese student association celebrating culture with events and night markets.
clubs.description: TSAUW promotes Taiwanese culture on campus with social events, night markets, and themed parties. Students gather to enjoy music, food, and celebrations that highlight Taiwan’s heritage.

clubs.name: Tea Club
clubs.about: Hosts relaxed tea gatherings for students to connect and share.
clubs.description: Tea Club invites anyone to enjoy relaxed tea gatherings, sharing food, conversation, and tea knowledge. Members meet regularly, share custom blends, and stay connected via a Discord community.

clubs.name: Technology and Business Association
clubs.about: Discusses technology and business trends through panels and interactive talks.
clubs.description: TBA UW blends tech and business topics in panels where professionals debate future mobility and innovation, encouraging student participation and voting.

clubs.name: TEDx at UofW
clubs.about: Student‑run TEDx chapter hosting talks and idea‑sharing events.
clubs.description: TEDxUofW brings together students, faculty, and community members to share inspiring ideas through live talks and performances. The organization seeks speakers who can spark change and spark conversation. Participate as an audience member or presenter to engage with cutting‑edge perspectives.

clubs.name: Thai Student Association at University of Washington
clubs.about: Thai student association hosting cultural and sports events at UW.
clubs.description: ThaiSA UW celebrates Thai culture and fosters friendships through events like Northwest Sports Day. Members enjoy games, sports, and community gatherings on campus.

clubs.name: The Association of Library and Information Science Students at the University of Washington
clubs.about: Supports UW library and information science students.
clubs.description: ALISS connects library and information science students through panels, mixers, and online events. It offers a space to learn about the MLIS program and meet peers across campuses.

clubs.name: the BASEMENT

clubs.description: The BASEMENT offers gallery shows and publishes magazines featuring student artwork. Events include openings with music, drinks, and opportunities to meet fellow artists.

clubs.name: The Black Student Journal
clubs.about: Publishes Black student writing and hosts reading discussions.
clubs.description: The Black Student Journal creates a space for literary exchange, hosting reading clubs, book exchanges, and discussions of works like W.E.B. Du Bois, fostering community among UW students.

clubs.name: The Dirty Dozen Student Farm Club
clubs.about: Student farm group exploring the full food system cycle on campus.
clubs.description: The Dirty Dozen is a UW student farm group that works the full food‑system cycle. Members meet for potlucks, plot work, and crafts while learning about sustainable agriculture.

clubs.name: The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students ( FIUTS ) Student Board
clubs.about: FIUTS (The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students) advances international understanding through…
clubs.description: FIUTS (The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students) advances international understanding through crosscultural experiences, student leadership, and community connections.

clubs.name: The Hiking Club at UW
clubs.about: Student hiking club exploring Washington’s trails year‑round.
clubs.description: The UW Hiking Club organizes regular hikes across Washington’s scenic spots, from waterfalls to mountain passes. Members connect on Discord for trip details, cold‑plunge sessions, and seasonal outings.

clubs.description: The Purple Group offers a safe, peer‑led space for undocumented and DACA students to share resources, study together, and celebrate their cultures. Regular meet‑ups include scholarship workshops, study nights, and community‑building activities.

clubs.name: The Women’s Network at UW
clubs.about: Women‑led network empowering ambition and community.
clubs.description: The Women’s Network at UW provides podcasts, socials, and events highlighting women in tech and leadership. Members gather for study dates, creative socials, and inspiring speaker talks.

clubs.name: Theta Xi Fraternity
clubs.about: Fraternity dedicated to leadership, service, and brotherhood.
clubs.description: Theta Xi is the Upsilon Chapter at UW, founded in 1915 and upholding a record of zero violations. The fraternity emphasizes leading and serving its members and community. Social events like Casino Night bring brothers together for fun.

clubs.description: UWiB empowers undergraduate women in business through philanthropy events, case‑study workshops, and speaker series. It fosters networking and professional growth across disciplines.

clubs.description: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN and strengthen the UN system. We advocate for the UN, stand up for human rights, and learn how to meet UN sustainability goals.

clubs.name: University of Washington SDS

clubs.description: UW SDS is a chapter of Students for a Democratic Society, focusing on democratic reforms, anti‑racist work, and campus activism. They organize teach‑ins, protests against trans‑phobic speakers, and campaigns like divestment from fossil‑fuel‑linked companies.

clubs.name: Urban Accessibility Group

clubs.description: WashPIRG at UW brings students together to research and advocate on public interest issues, from environmental policy to consumer protection. They run campaigns like Earth & Energy and host informational tables on campus. Join to learn, campaign, and make a difference.

clubs.name: Washington Women’s Lacrosse Club

clubs.name: Woof3D
clubs.about: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing.
clubs.description: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we have something for everyone. Experience is not required, and neither is any time commitment. During Fall Quarter, we hold weekly workshops mostly aimed towards beginners. These will teach the basics of 3D modeling in OnShape, as well as how to print using the club printers. We also provide members with the opportunity to work on a larger scale 3D printing project with other members throughout the year. Joining a team is not required, but it is a good way to get hands on experience and learn more about hardware and software in the process. Check out our website to learn more!

clubs.name: Writers in Progress
clubs.about: Interested in creative writing?
clubs.description: Interested in creative writing? We create a positive, casual space where people interested in a variety of forms of creative writing can meet and provide each other with support and feedback. Bring something to share or just come to chat! :)
